eligibility_evidence: The Hybrid Cloud Engineer supports the integration between on-premises VMware and Microsoft Windows-based infrastructure with cloud technologies.

YOUR KEY RESPONSIBILITIES: Assist in implementing hybrid cloud solutions based on established designs (on-premises and cloud-based) that meet the business’s technical and operational needs, particularly leveraging VMware and Microsoft Windows & SQL Server technologies.
Ensure efficient performance, scalability, and high availability across hybrid cloud platforms for Windows Server, and SQL workloads.
Provide input to help forecast and plan budgets related to hybrid cloud infrastructure.
review_candidates.requirements_excerpt: Ensure infrastructure security while keeping up with best practices and CCH requirements. Comply with the backup strategy and fulfil the organization’s business continuity and data retention requirements. Infrastructure Deployment & Optimization Hands-on experience with VMware vSphere, vCenter, and Azure Arc for hybrid cloud management. Automation of operational tasks Proficiency in PowerShell for scripting and automation. Software Licensing & Cost Management Proficient in managing and optimizing Microsoft, VMware, and SQL licensing.
